title: High-voltage line current
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates I₂ = P₃ / U₃, yielding 50 A.

title: Step-up transformer ratio
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates n₁:n₂ = U₁:U₂, yielding 1:16.

title: Conversion efficiency
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly calculates η = (P₁ / P₀) × 100%, yielding 40%.

title: Power conservation reasoning
description: Important Criteria: Applies power conservation (P₃ = P₄, P₁ = P₃ + ΔP) to link generator, transmission, and user power.

title: Voltage drop calculation
description: Important Criteria: Uses Ohm's law (ΔU = I₂ r) to find the 200 V loss in the transmission line.

title: Transformer voltage relations
description: Important Criteria: Applies ideal transformer law (U₃/U₄ = n₃/n₄, U₁/U₂ = n₁/n₂) to find U₃ and the step-up ratio.

title: Water mechanical power
description: Important Criteria: Calculates the available mechanical power from water using P₀ = ρ Q g h, yielding 5 × 10⁵ W.

title: Sign or unit confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Confuses step-up/step-down transformer ratios or misapplies voltage addition (U₂ = U₃ + ΔU vs. U₂ = U₃ - ΔU).

title: Power formula misuse
description: Pitfall Criteria: Uses P = U²/R or P = I U incorrectly for the transmission line, or misidentifies which power (P₃, P₄, P₁) to use in calculations.
